en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub,from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajjal who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Give charity and go out in whichever day you so desire to’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj who has said the following: “
Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘You should give charity and leave for your journey any time you like.’”
